Lara Kim: FYI — Fenwick enablement next Tue 4pm PT. Customer asked for a short exec intro + breakout labs. I'm on PTO that day, need coverage and a quick plan. :calendar:
Diego Mendez: I can run the exec intro (10m) and highlight adoption metrics. Who can own breakout 1 (migration) and breakout 2 (ops)?
Priya Sharma: I can take breakout 2 (ops/runbook/troubleshooting). Prefer to keep it 25m.
Noah Grant: I'll take breakout 1 (migration checklist + blockers). Can do live triage too.
Lara Kim: Proposed agenda:
```
4:00-4:10pm PT — Exec intro & success signals (Diego)
4:10-4:35pm PT — Breakout 1: Migration walkthrough (Noah)
4:35-5:00pm PT — Breakout 2: Ops/runbook + Qs (Priya)
5:00-5:10pm PT — Synthesis & next steps (Diego)
```
Diego Mendez: I'll shorten intro to 8m and leave 2m for immediate asks. Also will enable recording and note for execs.
Priya Sharma: I'll post a condensed runbook link and a troubleshooting cheatsheet 24h before.
Noah Grant: I'll attach the prioritized blockers list (they flagged 5 items; 2 are renewal-level). Will call those out in breakout.
Lara Kim: Important: renewal review in 10 days. Post-session action items need to feed Renewals: outstanding blockers with owners + migration ETA. Can we capture that during synthesis?
Priya Sharma: I'll capture CSAT + feedback form responses and tag owners in notes. I'll use the standard capture template.
Diego Mendez: I'll synthesize notes and push to the renewal tracker. Noah/Priya — please add owner tags inline so I can copy.
OnboardingBot: Fenwick enablement event updated by Diego Mendez. 39 RSVPs. Recording enabled.
Noah Grant: Lab VM and pre-read link posted: https://internal.docs/fenwick-prep (internal).
Priya Sharma: Troubleshooting cheat-sheet draft: https://internal.docs/fenwick-cheats (internal).
Lara Kim: Thanks — if anything changes react :x: here. Otherwise I'll mark this covered and update the event owner to Diego.
Diego Mendez: Updated event owner and added "renewal action" section to notes. Will ping Renewals after I synthesize.
Priya Sharma: I'll run the feedback form and export results to the CSAT tracker. Form link: https://forms.internal/fenwick-feedback
Noah Grant: I'll queue a post-session follow-up email for the attendees with migration next steps.
Lara Kim: Perfect. Final ask: each owner react :white_check_mark: when your prep is posted.
Diego Mendez: ✅
Priya Sharma: ✅
Noah Grant: ✅
OnboardingBot: Reminder: Fenwick enablement 24h and 1h prior.
